prose: We are taught that Western civilization began with the Greeks, but the linguistic evidence reveals a much older, "secret" seafaring empire that was systematically erased from our history books.

In this remastered episode, we decode the "Ocean Language" of the Pelasgians, the Holy Sailors who mastered the Mediterranean and the Americas long before the Bronze Age collapse. By decoding the Hebrew and Phoenician roots hidden in plain sight, we reveal why the Pelasgians were the original 'Lordly' tribe mentioned in the oldest texts. Join Chance Garton and Dylan Saccoccio as they pull back the philological veil on the true architects of our world.
This is a remastered episode originally published March 15th 2024. Inner Whirled Episode 2.
